protocol.contrast: V14 success minus matching pure-draft success
protocol.interval: Two-sided percentile bootstrap, 2.5th/97.5th percentiles with linear interpolation (type7)
protocol.case_bootstrap: Resample n paired case differences with replacement; same sampled indices for both conditions.
protocol.mother_task_cluster_bootstrap: Resample m mother-task clusters uniformly with replacement, retain every case within each chosen cluster, and compute sum(paired differences)/sum(case counts). Overall clusters are not suite-stratified.
protocol.estimand: Case-weighted success-rate difference; cluster resampling retains unequal observed cluster sizes rather than changing to an equal-task estimand.
protocol.scope: Intervals are descriptive sensitivity summaries on known historical data, not preregistered confirmatory inference; no p-values are computed.
protocol.multiplicity: Subgroup intervals are unadjusted descriptive intervals; no across-subgroup significance ranking.

case210_initial_NPZ_check.meaning: The prior Full-image exception is not an initial-input mismatch in the primary V14 vs pure-draft contrast.

original20_context.reason: Original20 and perturbed175 differ in mother-task coverage and initial states; no same-task same-init unperturbed counterpart assignment is established.
